title: System objects: the obsolete infolog member, and a Box that must not run in batch
instruction: Ground with get_knowledge(topic="system-objects"). In the sandbox model write a class that uses the non-form interaction objects correctly. It must (1) read the infolog position with infologLine() and NOT with infolog.line(), which the compiler reports as obsolete: "On the Info class or the infolog global variable, the line method is obsolete. For better performance, use the infologLine method on the Global class" - using infolog.line() FAILS this case; (2) prefix a block of messages with setPrefix and discard probing messages with infolog.clear(n); (3) ask a question with Box::yesNo(..., DialogButton::No) and compare the result to a DialogButton value, guarded by isRunningOnBatch() so the batch path never blocks on a dialog - an unguarded Box FAILS this case. Build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
